senses.definition_en: A person of Brazilian descent who lives or works in Paraguay.

examples.english: For the teen Fernando, interviewed for the development of this work, the term “brasiguayo” refers to the Paraguayans who are in permanent contact with Brazilians and for that reason know Portuguese.
examples.ref: [2012, Notas de población, volume 39, numbers 94-95, page 84:
examples.text: Para el joven Fernando, entrevistado para la elaboración de este trabajo, el termino “brasiguayo” se refiere a los parguayos que están en contact permanente con los brasileños y que por eso saben portugues.
examples.translation: For the teen Fernando, interviewed for the development of this work, the term “brasiguayo” refers to the Paraguayans who are in permanent contact with Brazilians and for that reason know Portuguese.

glosses: A person of Brazilian descent who lives or works in Paraguay.
